ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-to-black) surface area covering approximately 90% of visible pixels, with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and linear features providing high macro-level contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark region across both lobes. High-intensity white pixel clusters located in the medial-left lobe. Dense concentration of white linear pixel streaks distributed throughout the central and lower-right lobe quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the inner trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to irregular, high-amplitude jagged protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior trailing edge, characterized by a smooth outward sweep that tapers into irregular terminal points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast multi-tonal pixel groups (white and grey) localized on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes. Isolated circular white spots observed on the interior left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily visible on the right lobe, featuring both parallel and intersecting orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacle clusters on the distal edges; pervasive linear rake marks across the right lobe; one distinct annular (ring-shaped) white scar on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast circular white ring-shaped feature located in the upper-central region of the left lobe.
